parties: M.T. Sithy Fathima v. Damayanthi Perera M.T. Sithy Fathima v. Damayanthi Perera View More
keywords: District Court dismissed the plaintiff\'s action for a declaration of title on the ground that she was herself a tenant under the National Housing Authority and therefore could not maintain the action. Held - found the District Court\'s application of the relevant law was flawless and saw no reason to interfere; therefore, appeal dismissed without costs.
